hunks.sol: The Five-Star Red Flag of the People’s Republic of China was emblazoned on the chest of his armor.

hunks.baseline: At the young man’s question, those who had been about to flee stopped in their tracks.
hunks.sol: At the young man’s question, those about to flee stopped in their tracks.

hunks.sol: Shao Shen glared at the monster army charging from several hundred meters away. From beneath his low-pulled helmet, his thunderous voice erupted once more.
